text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um! Um, excuse me! I have a favor to ask, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
C-Could you please take a picture of 
meee!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My family told me they want to see me here 
at Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've sent that so many times already, you 
know? And yet, my sister is being 
especially persistent...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
He's definitely making fun of me! That's 
why I want a totally flawless shot to show 
him who's boss! Please lend me a hand~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, we decided to take a 'look at 
me looking sharp!' photo of her, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I look forward to working with 
you! *salute*

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's a prop! The title is: 'Chiyono O 
Reading a Book, Undisturbed by the 
Commotion'!
choice_data_list: …Do you always read in the hallway?

…Do you always read books out in the 
hallway?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's not it... but, I was just 
thinking it looks like a composition you 
see in magazines a lot...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...D-Does this not suit me? Then how about 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well then... Trainer, I leave it to... 
you. Phew...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Here's some coffee for you... and me. Kind 
of like... 'Chiyono O standing with coffee 
in hand'.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh. Um... It's... City-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The other day, City-san was in a magazine 
brushing her hair back with coffee in 
hand, and it was so incredibly cool!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“Still, did it really feel a bit off just 
because it was me? Hmm...”
choice_data_list:
I like you best when you're just being 
yourself.

You're at your best when you're just being 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? Ehehe, in that case, I'll 
just be myself...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Huh!? Act natural... LIKE THIS!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she overthought things and ended 
up confused. To help her return to her 
natural self...
choice_data_list: Why not show your family in person?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So "I am who I am because of my 
friends"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Taking photos with everyone in the 
classroom feels kind of fresh and new~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san, Yaeno-san! Thank you so much 
for your help~!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Like this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How valiant. However, it might be lacking 
a little bit of that Chiyono O charm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
How about taking a photo where we're all 
lined up together, pretending to take 
notes? I think it would show off our 
studious, 'characteristic' side.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It certainly feels true to Chiyono O-san, 
but... since it's a photo to show your 
family, wouldn't they prefer seeing you 
look a bit more cheerful?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, would it be 'Way~ 
to go'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios often says it... Perhaps it is 
a sort of signal that a fun time is about 
to begin.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...No, please wait a moment. If it were a 
signal, wouldn't saying "Way~y" multiple 
times during a conversation be unnatural?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft! Saying 'way to go' with a 
completely straight face... Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Was that strange? In that case, how 
about... 'We're besties for life, yay~'... 
or something along those lines? I have 
heard that before.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...How about we take a step back from the 
'Waaaay~'? I believe that's unique to 
Helios-san, so it might be a bit too 
advanced for us."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the shape! What a nice idea! They say 
"a party is all in the mood," so let's 
make our own original "woohoo"!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that just boil down to being a 
party animal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A natural smile returned to Sakura Chiyono 
O's face. Without missing the moment, I 
snapped a photo of her chatting and 
laughing with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
âAh, did you see the photo? Ehehe, isn't 
my friend wonderful~âª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I saw her happily boasting 
to her family as she sent them photos 
taken with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehh~!! You're going to livestream it!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~... But we haven't talked much 
lately... Maybe it's... okay...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I took a camera and decided to 
deliver footage of her inside the academy 
directly to her family.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "...Whoa!? Everyone's here!?"

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, you called on video out of 
nowhere, sis! Of course I'd think 
something was wrong!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You LANEd me yesterday, didn't you?! 
Saying you wanted to see me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! How is it? Your long-awaited 
Onee-chan in Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Second Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, is that place really Tracen 
Academy? Are you sure you're not just 
messing with me~?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's mean! I picked a spot where nobody 
was looking~! It's still properly within 
Tracen Academy, you know!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Eldest Brother
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha. Chiyo, since you're here, why not 
show me around a bit? I'd love to see 
inside the academy."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother... Um, Trainer, is it okay if 
we move?"

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, my sister's Trainer!? No way, turn 
the camera toward them!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you really not care about me 
anymore~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Sakura Chiyono O stayed 
on the phone with her family for a while—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—My sister is so mean! Apparently she was 
screenshotting yesterday's livestream, and 
sent me a whole bunch of them~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And they're all awkward ones where my eyes 
are half-closed! Ugh, she used to cling to 
me and be so cute, but lately she's gotten 
so cheeky...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My middle brother's super mean to me, too. 
The only one on my side is my eldest 
brother~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Saying that, Sakura Chiyono O looked 
somehow delighted.
